proofRoutes.assessment: Upstream representation theorem applies to nonempty standard-Borel I and arbitrary measurable history carrier; each Markov kernel has joint measurable uniform representation at every history. Classical family choice fixes one f before any nu. No assumed representation result is smuggled into the public signature.

Finite recursion measurability is proved by induction, restriction of prefixes, joint hf, and last/castSucc cases. Separate induction proves each stored action equals the matching infinite-input prediction. Causality follows from literal equality of finite inputs and equality of current uniform. All deterministic conclusions hold at t=0 with empty prefix.

Independent tape coordinates give independence of past uniforms and current uniform. Product game law supplies independence of entire outcome stream from that pair. Existing independent_private_seed_pair regroups these facts; measurable recursion maps the resulting block to generated history. Current draw has exact volume law, and joint pushforward is transformed using the all-history h-kappa. This proves compProd, not independent action/history law. The local product-law helper uses measurable sets and exact integrals, not a vacuous zero-map branch.

Prediction measurability comes from T2, and T3 supplies exact joint factorization. Upstream conditional disintegration uniqueness yields equality only under actual history marginal. The source graph D-JOINT OR-route is implemented; D-TESTS is not an additional requirement or actual proof dependency. Although upstream theorem admits a non-AE-measurable-X branch, actual generated history is measurable by the explicit T3 construction, so this is not vacuous closure.

T1 and T2 select a single f, then all nu are introduced. T3/T4 supply law clauses. IID/common-law/support are lifted from observation marginal to product game. Existing randomized_history_policy_expectedFixed_excess receives full tape as seed and a measurable Fin/range-reindexed causal policy. Feasibility is derived from I subtype for all seed/history inputs; it is stronger than the old legal-history premise without adding a public assumption. Current-outcome independence and L2 integrability are derived by reused producer. The analytic mean is not used to construct f.

truthBoundary: Five derived contracts, not five printed source theorems. Stage1 source/application gaps retain provenance even when compatible dependencies now discharge implementation obligations.
One sampler before all observation laws/horizons; product model only, no adaptive environment coupled to current action.
T4 only history-law-a.e. conditional identity; no equality on every null history or all-nu common exceptional set.
IID/support only final T5 risk clause; no sublinear rate, executable realization, arbitrary state/action policy equivalence, chapter/book completion.
Focused imported verification is not full shared project/harness/site/render/CI/main/live acceptance or original PR closure.
